tool_cue_on_null.cue_text: 0 Drive hits for the name term 'jefaki-arm2-nonexistent' — a null that is easy to over-read. Drive matches whole name TOKENS, not substrings: names split on punctuation, spaces and letter-digit boundaries (report-2026.pdf tokenises to report, 2026, pdf), a multi-token term is an AND of its whole tokens in any order, and the only substring honoured is a literal prefix of the ENTIRE name — so report-20 matches, eport-2026 never can. If the file may exist: retry with one whole token, exact equality (name = with the full filename), a fullText search, or a folder listing. Measured 2026-08-24 (mise-jefaki).
